caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP row 20630 records 88.3% cell death at 100 uM, while local source text supports 22.70% viability, equivalent to 77.30% cell death.
APD6 AP03818/AP03819 entry text includes 2024 parasite/serum and approximate HEK293 IC50 claims not supported by this 2023 local article.
